test_title: PYST 24: Selection Post (Graduate Level) - GA (Held On 26 Jul, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: Which government scheme aims to provide affordable housing to the urban poor and economically weaker sections?

options.text: Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)
Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission (DAY-NULM)

solution:
The correct answer is __**Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e3594069eb4eac3d559af7c626aabe4ee4145967932cf8ad78e35476f134a4b8.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Pradhan Mantri Awas Yojana - Urban (PMAY-U)** was launched on **25th June 2015** by the **Ministry of Housing and Urban Affairs (MoHUA)** to address the housing shortage among the urban poor.
 
• Its primary objective is to provide **Housing for All** by ensuring every eligible urban household has access to an all-weather **pucca house** with basic civic amenities.
 
• The mission specifically targets **Economically Weaker Sections (EWS)**, **Low Income Groups (LIG)**, and **Middle Income Groups (MIG)**, including slum dwellers.
 
• The scheme is implemented through four key verticals: **In-situ Slum Redevelopment (ISSR)**, **Credit Linked Subsidy Scheme (CLSS)**, **Affordable Housing in Partnership (AHP)**, and **Beneficiary-led Construction (BLC)**.
 
• Originally intended to complete its targets by 2022, the **Union Cabinet** extended the implementation period for all verticals except CLSS until **31st December 2024**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/3e20068b61817b168623bbf4377a66602deb382bfb1e34ae29a5e35078dcefcb.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Atal Mission for Rejuvenation and Urban Transformation (AMRUT)**:

 
 
• Launched in **2015**, it focuses on improving urban infrastructure, specifically **water supply**, **sewerage networks**, and **stormwater drainage** to upgrade the quality of life in cities.
 
 
 
• **Smart Cities Mission**:
 
 
• This mission aims to develop **100 cities** across India by integrating **digital technology**, sustainable environment practices, and efficient public transport to improve urban living standards.
 
 
 
• **DAY-NULM (Deendayal Antyodaya Yojana-National Urban Livelihoods Mission)**:
 
 
• This scheme focuses on reducing the poverty and vulnerability of urban poor households by providing **skill training**, **self-employment** opportunities, and credit facilities for micro-enterprises.
